rows.question: where can i get free food on campus tonight lol im broke
rows.answer:
Money stress is really common, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

Tonight is Wednesday, so the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons satellite pantry is open until 12:00 a.m. It has free grab-and-go items, including microwave soups and meals, granola and/or breakfast bars, and protein shakes. [1]

The Birch Tree Inn has late-night dining Wednesday from 9 pm to 11pm, but it isn’t free: you can pay with a Meal Plan, Flex, Ramapo Dollars, cash or credit. [15]

For five free meals at Birch Tree Inn, currently enrolled students experiencing food insecurity can apply through the Swipe Out Hunger Application: [https://cglink.me/2fF/s60806](https://cglink.me/2fF/s60806). Availability is limited; students with the Ultimate or Maroon 14 meal plans are not eligible. New applicants and students without a meal plan get priority; repeat applicants may be considered case-by-case. [6]

**Dining Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7773. Location: Student Center, 1st Floor. [32]

These offices can help:
- **Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [33]
- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [33]
